items.text: Fixed collision issues with the large rig monument blocker, improving building placement near rigs.
Pipe access fixes: trees no longer spawn inside water pipes and terrain transitions near pipes are smoother.
Sleepers are now correctly killed in safezones after a server restart.

2026-08-31.summary:
### Monuments & World
- Fixed collision issues with the large rig monument blocker, improving building placement near rigs.
- Pipe access fixes: trees no longer spawn inside water pipes and terrain transitions near pipes are smoother.

### Base & Deployables
- Improved carvable pumpkin deployment reliability.

### Players & Safety
- Sleepers are now correctly killed in safezones after a server restart.

### Animals & NPCs
- Frog AI behavior fixed, preventing movement glitches.
- Enhanced critter state handling for more reliable behavior overrides.

### UI
- Clan tag text on player nameplates now aligns correctly when auto‑sized.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Players can now connect water pipes on the beach area, expanding placement options.
- Circuit updates now apply immediately when components change mid‑tick, fixing delayed or missing reactions.

items.text: Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).
Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.

2026-08-30.summary:
### Audio & Communication
- Heavy plate helmets now muffle player voice more strongly (volume reduction lowered from 2400 to 1800).

### Gameplay & Balance
- Reduced pipe hole mesh size and adjusted anchor setup to eliminate terrain gaps, preventing unintended openings in structures.

items.text: Explosive ammo now damages monument blockers as intended.
Crates and barrels on both oil rigs now respawn correctly after being looted.
Siege tower doors function properly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam on them.
Fixed a bug where deployable structures could display random skins, ensuring they keep their intended appearance.

2026-08-29.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Explosive ammo now damages monument blockers as intended.

### Monuments & World
- Crates and barrels on both oil rigs now respawn correctly after being looted.

### Siege & Vehicles
- Siege tower doors function properly and NPCs no longer get stuck when doors slam on them.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Fixed a bug where deployable structures could display random skins, ensuring they keep their intended appearance.
